changelog:
Initial release of python-flow-engine.

- Lightweight Python flow orchestration library with no external dependencies.
- Build data processing pipelines with serial (>>), parallel (//), and conditional (|/connect) execution.
- Core API includes Node and Pipeline classes for pipeline construction and execution.
- Supports node-level timeouts and retry logic for robust error handling.
- Provides pipeline visualization via Mermaid.js flowcharts.
- Includes core library and a demo script covering six scenarios.
